description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere, adding {G}.
Myr Battlesphere dies, triggering Mortuary, putting Myr Battlesphere on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Call of the Wild by paying {2}{G}{G}, revealing Myr Battlesphere from the top of your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Myr tokens, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Call of the Wild's ability to put all creature cards from your library onto the battlefield.
